title: Coefficient-system lift of the augmented ambient projection mate
statement:
Let $f:(\mathscr X,R_X)\to(\mathscr Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by sites small in the coefficient universe, with a specified ring isomorphism $f^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$ [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Let $J=\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ and let $Q_{Y,\bullet}$ be a strict inverse system of commutative $R_Y$-algebra sheaves with unital algebra transitions; put $Q_{X,\bullet}=f^{-1}Q_{Y,\bullet}$ with its pulled-back structure. A $Q_T$-module system is a strict family of $Q_{T,n}$-module sheaves whose transitions are linear along the ring transitions. Realize these as modules over $Q_T$ on the small diagram topos [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], and use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $U_T$ for exact restriction from $Q_T$-module systems to strict $R_T$-module towers [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $F=f^*$ be exact ambient pullback, $G=Rf_*$ its derived right adjoint, and let $F_Q\dashv G_Q$ be the induced derived adjunction on the ringed diagram topoi [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. For $K\in D(R_T)$ set $\mathcal B_TK=\Delta K\otimes^L_{\Delta R_T}Q_T$ as a $Q_T$-module system [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Then $B_T=U_T\mathcal B_T$ is the strict reduction functor, with quotient augmentation $i_T$, of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower].

The canonical derived scalar/pullback isomorphism $\tau^Q:F_Q\mathcal B_Y\cong\mathcal B_XF$, normalized by $f^{-1}(x\otimes q)\mapsto f^{-1}x\otimes f^{-1}q$ on flat-term K-flat representatives, defines by adjunction a natural morphism of derived $Q_Y$-module systems
$$\beta_K:\mathcal B_Y(GK)\longrightarrow G_Q\mathcal B_XK,$$
whose transpose is $\mathcal B_X(\varepsilon_K)\tau^Q_{GK}$ for the ambient counit $\varepsilon:FG\to1$. Under the canonical restriction/direct-image comparison $d:U_YG_Q\cong G^{\rm Tow}U_X$ [lem-pur-diagram-ring-restriction-pushforward], one has
$$d\,U_Y(\beta_K)=h_K,$$
where $h_K:B_Y(GK)\to G^{\rm Tow}B_XK$ is precisely the augmented ambient projection mate [lem-weil-pbc-augmented-diagram-projection-mate]. Evaluation identifies $\beta_{K,n}$ in $D(Q_{Y,n})$ with the $Q_{Y,n}$-linear adjunct of the tensor-pullback comparison followed by $\varepsilon_K\otimes1$, and its restriction to $D(R_Y)$ with the evaluated ambient projection map. These are comparisons of derived strict systems before evaluation. They commute with all $Q_{Y,b}\to Q_{Y,a}$ and satisfy, after restriction,
$$d\,U_Y(\beta_K)i_{Y,GK}=G^{\rm Tow}(i_{X,K})\chi_K,$$
with the canonical constant-tower comparison $\chi$ in the augmented-mate node. If every evaluation of $h_K$ is an isomorphism, then $\beta_K$ and each $\beta_{K,n}$ are isomorphisms. No perfectness, flatness of $R_T\to Q_{T,n}$, completeness, or boundedness assumption is made.

proof.text: Work on the small diagram topoi. Put $A_T=\Delta R_T$, $E_T=(-\otimes^L_{A_T}Q_T)$ and $F_A=F^{\rm Tow}$, so $\mathcal B_T=E_T\Delta_T$. The scalar map $A_T\to Q_T$ gives a ringed-topos morphism with identity underlying topos, whose derived pullback is $E_T$ and whose derived direct image is the exact $U_T$. Hence $E_T\dashv U_T$ is the canonical ringed derived adjunction. The two factorizations of the ringed diagram morphism from $(\mathscr X^J,Q_X)$ to $(\mathscr Y^J,A_Y)$ give $c:F_QE_Y\cong E_XF_A$ and $d:U_YG_Q\cong G^{\rm Tow}U_X$. Apply the canonical derived-composition comparisons: they identify the two composite adjunctions, not merely their object assignments. The $d$ here is the specified restriction/direct-image comparison, since both are normalized by those same composition maps. All these sites are small, and both geometric inverse images are exact because both structural coefficient maps are isomorphisms.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); apply to the identity-topos scalar morphisms and their composite with f

proof.text: Compose $c$ with $F_A\Delta_Y=\Delta_XF$ to define $\tau^Q:F_Q\mathcal B_Y\cong\mathcal B_XF$. On a flat-term K-flat representative $P$, the comparison is the $Q_X$-linear map $f^{-1}(x\otimes q)\mapsto f^{-1}x\otimes f^{-1}q$. It is compatible with a transition $q\mapsto\rho_{ba}(q)$: either composite sends the displayed tensor to $f^{-1}x\otimes f^{-1}\rho_{ba}(q)$. These are maps on the diagram site. Canonical K-flat scalar representatives and the normalized pullback-composition comparisons descend them to the derived diagram categories. Their restrictions are exactly the representative-normalized comparison $\tau$ of the reduction-pullback node: both conjugate this same ordinary tensor map by the resolution comparisons. Consequently, writing $a:F_AU_Y\cong U_XF_Q$ for the inverse-image/restriction identification, $U_X(\tau^Q)\,a_{\mathcal B_Y}=\tau$, under $U_T\mathcal B_T=B_T$. No flatness of $A_T\to Q_T$ is used: only the chosen source representative is K-flat.

source.place: Tags 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product), with their flat-term K-flat representative normalization

proof.text:
Here is the counit calculation needed for restricting a mate. Denote the units of $E_T\dashv U_T$ by $u_T$, and the counits of $F_A\dashv G^{\rm Tow}$ and $F_Q\dashv G_Q$ by $\varepsilon_A,\varepsilon_Q$. By the composite-adjunction compatibility from step 1, the mate of $c$ has the following formula for each $N$:
$$d_N=G^{\rm Tow}U_X(\varepsilon_{Q,N})\,G^{\rm Tow}U_XF_Q(v_Y)\,G^{\rm Tow}U_X(c^{-1})\,G^{\rm Tow}(u_X)\,\eta_{A,U_YG_QN},$$
where $v_Y:E_YU_Y\to1$ is the scalar counit; the omitted subscripts are the unique well-typed ones. The middle three arrows compose to $G^{\rm Tow}(a_{G_QN})$: before applying $G^{\rm Tow}$ the map is
$$F_AU_YM\xrightarrow{u_X}U_XE_XF_AU_YM\xrightarrow{U_Xc^{-1}}U_XF_QE_YU_YM\xrightarrow{U_XF_Q(v_Y)}U_XF_QM.$$
It is $a_M$. Apply the scalar-adjunct formula of [lem-coef-sequence-adjunction-cochain-transposes] on the diagram site, with the constant sequence $B_n=Q_T$ over $A_T$: the derived adjunct of a chain map $g:P\otimes_{A_T}Q_T\to K$ is represented by $x\mapsto g(x\otimes1)$ for every flat-term K-flat $A_T$-complex $P$. This is the canonical adjunction $E_T\dashv U_T$ of step 1, as both are derived from the ordinary scalar adjunction. Hence on a flat-term K-flat representative $P\to U_YM$, $u_X$ is $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ on $F_AP$ and $v_Y$ is multiplication. By step 1, $c^{-1}$ is the ordinary pullback reassociation on these representatives, so the composite sends $f^{-1}x$ to $f^{-1}x\otimes1$, then to $f^{-1}(x\otimes1)$, and then to $f^{-1}x$. Thus $d_N=G^{\rm Tow}(U_X\varepsilon_{Q,N}\,a_{G_QN})\eta_{A,U_YG_QN}$. Taking the inverse Hom bijection gives
$$\varepsilon_{A,U_XN}\,F_A(d_N)=U_X(\varepsilon_{Q,N})\,a_{G_QN}.$$
This is a formal composite-adjunction and triangle-identity calculation; it does not assume that derived scalar restriction is faithful.

proof.text: For $K\in D(R_X)$ define $t_K=\mathcal B_X(\varepsilon_K)\tau^Q_{GK}$ and let $\beta_K$ be its adjunct under $F_Q\dashv G_Q$. This is a morphism in $D(Q_Y)$ on the diagram topos. Both factors of $t_K$ are natural in $K$, so naturality of the adjunction Hom bijection makes $\beta$ natural. Its defining transpose is precisely $t_K$, rather than an arbitrary coefficient-linear lift of an ambient arrow.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint) and 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map), construction by adjunction on the ringed diagram topoi

proof.text:
Compute the $F_A\dashv G^{\rm Tow}$ transpose of $d\,U_Y(\beta_K)$. Step 3 and naturality of $a$ give, with $N=\mathcal B_XK$,
$$\varepsilon_A F_A(d\,U_Y\beta_K)=U_X(\varepsilon_Q)\,a_{G_QN}F_A(U_Y\beta_K)=U_X(t_K)\,a_{\mathcal B_YGK}.$$
Step 2 identifies this with $B_X(\varepsilon_K)\tau_{GK}$. The augmented ambient-mate node states that $h_K$ is the adjunct of this very map. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection therefore gives $d\,U_Y(\beta_K)=h_K$ as derived strict-system morphisms. The equality has been proved in the ambient derived diagram category, before evaluation.

source.place: Tag 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map), uniqueness under the adjunction Hom bijection; Tags 07A6 and 0FPI for its normalization

proof.text: Apply the algebra-diagram evaluation/adjunction-normalization node with $A=\mathbf Z$, $u=f$, $B_T=Q_T$ and $J=\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{\rm op}$. Every commutative ring sheaf is canonically a constant-$\mathbf Z$ algebra, so this application imposes no condition that $R_T$ be constant. It supplies $e_{Y,n}G_Q\cong G_{Q_n}e_{X,n}$ and the formula that evaluation takes an actual transpose to the levelwise transpose. The evaluation/scalar comparison $e_{T,n}\mathcal B_TK\cong K\otimes^L_{R_T}Q_{T,n}$ is the pullback-composition comparison for the ringed evaluation morphism: its inverse image on $Q_T$-modules is exact evaluation, and composing it with scalar extension and $\Delta_T$ has structural ring map $R_T\to Q_{T,n}$. The canonical composition theorem computes it by the same flat-term tensor representatives. Applying these comparisons to $t_K$ therefore gives the tensor-pullback comparison followed by $\varepsilon_K\otimes1$. Hence the evaluated $\beta_{K,n}$ is its $Q_{Y,n}$-linear adjunct. Evaluating the equality in step 5 gives its stated ambient restriction, using the ambient evaluation normalization and evaluated formula for $h$ in the augmented-mate node.

The construction uses adjunctions on the diagram topoi throughout. Therefore the source, target and $\beta$ are strict derived systems, and the transition compatibility is that of a morphism in their derived system category. The evaluation comparisons used in step 6 are natural for the semilinear coefficient transitions. Finally substitute step 5 into the augmentation equality of the augmented-mate node:
$$d\,U_Y(\beta_K)i_{Y,GK}=h_Ki_{Y,GK}=G^{\rm Tow}(i_{X,K})\chi_K.$$
This derives the augmentation identity as an equality of derived strict towers, without attempting to infer an equality of morphisms from equality of evaluations.

source.place: Tag 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map); unitality and the augmented diagram mate identity

proof.text: Suppose every evaluation of $h_K$ is invertible. Evaluation is jointly conservative on derived strict systems, so $h_K$ is invertible as an ambient tower morphism. Step 5 and invertibility of $d$ make $U_Y\beta_K$ invertible. Exact scalar restriction reflects acyclicity: it changes neither the underlying sheaf of abelian groups nor kernels and cokernels, so $U_YH^r(C)=H^r(U_YC)$, and $U_YH^r(C)=0$ implies $H^r(C)=0$. Apply this to the cone of $\beta_K$ to conclude that $\beta_K$ is invertible. Every evaluation functor preserves isomorphisms, so each $\beta_{K,n}$ is invertible as well. This proves the last assertion for all the unbounded inputs allowed in the statement.
